title: DatasetCaseSpec
description: One evaluation case as it is imported into and exported from a dataset: one JSON object per line of a JSONL file. `input` is what the agent is asked; `expected_features` is what a run must satisfy. Written and read by app/modules/evaluation/application/dataset_format.py.

input.description: A string is the text sent to the agent. An object is stored as it is; the agent is asked the last user message of its `messages`, else its `input_summary`, else its `input`, else the object serialised as JSON.

expected_features.description: At least one expectation: a case that asserts nothing passes whatever the agent says.

minimum_output_terms.description: Terms the output must contain, compared case-insensitively.

max_latency_ms.description: Fail when the run takes longer than this.

max_cost_amount.description: Fail when the run costs more than this, in the run's currency.

llm_judge.description: Score the output against a rubric with a judge model; fails below min_score (default 0.7).
